title: First Macro-Allocation Epoch Attrition Topology Audit
question: Across the complete first macro-program allocation epoch Units 039-050, where did research information materially attrit: before authoritative evidence, between authority and a material finding, or between a material finding and an implementable selected candidate?
hypothesis: The macro Frontier may be constrained at several independent layers rather than by one research topic: evidence can fail before economics, valid economics can be too weak or narrow, and material diagnoses can still fail to translate into an implementable candidate. Measuring all three on one fixed epoch prevents overreacting to any single successful or failed family.
why_now: Unit 050 closed a broad portfolio interaction after the first complete macro-allocation epoch reached Units 039-050 and all Programs 1-5 and 7. A bounded Program 7 audit can now compare the entire epoch once before the next economic unit, without continuing Program 5 allocation or returning to adjacent signal, rates, session or RC4 work.

macro_recomparison.program_1: Unit 048 is recent and closed with no signal-transition field; no adjacent signal work opens.
macro_recomparison.program_2: Unit 049 is recent and closed with no rates context; no adjacent external-market work opens.
macro_recomparison.program_3: Unit 047 is recent and closed with no week-edge field; no adjacent timing work opens.
macro_recomparison.program_4: Units 040 and 046 did not yield clean authoritative management economics, but the available tracked state does not support a broad nonadjacent management mechanism without repair or substitution.
macro_recomparison.program_5: Unit 050 just closed with one-way book support and expressly no allocation successor.
macro_recomparison.program_7: Selected for one finite whole-epoch attrition audit, structurally distinct from Unit 043's evidence-acquisition-lane comparison.
macro_recomparison.after_close: Return to Programs 1-5 and 7. Do not open an adjacent Program 7 census, scheduler rule or audit extension.

variants.transition: all declared closed units to authoritative verdicts
material findings to implementable selected candidates

distinction_from_unit_043.unit_043_question: Unit 043 compared authoritative-answer yield between tracked aggregation and fresh-market observer acquisition lanes for Units 023-042.
distinction_from_unit_043.unit_051_question: Unit 051 does not compare acquisition modalities. It follows every macro-allocated unit 039-050 through authority, materiality and candidate translation, including units after 043.
distinction_from_unit_043.no_repair_or_default_lane: The result cannot repair an invalid unit, prescribe tracked evidence as a default, suppress fresh market work or extend Unit 043.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Only census membership, closure file existence, bytes, hashes and top-level schema property names were inspected. Verdict values, attrition classifications, stage counts, rates, gates and Unit 051 verdict were not aggregated.

fixed_normalization.authoritative_verdict: A closure is authoritative when its top-level verdict does not begin INVALID_ or AMBIGUOUS_. Closed negative, PASS_ and PARTIAL_ verdicts are authoritative.
fixed_normalization.material_finding: An authoritative closure is material when its top-level verdict begins PASS_ or PARTIAL_. This includes bounded economic and meta diagnoses but does not equate them with alpha or a trading candidate.
fixed_normalization.implementable_selected_candidate: A material closure reaches candidate translation only when a top-level selected_candidate, selected_trading_candidate, selected_threshold or promotion field contains a non-null, nonempty value other than NONE or none that identifies an implementable selected candidate at that unit's closure. A retained seed or later question alone is not a selected candidate.
fixed_normalization.retained_question_context: Separately report whether a material closure retained a non-null seed or later question under its schema. This is context only and does not pass candidate translation.
fixed_normalization.invalid_unit_role: An invalid unit counts only in evidence-authority attrition. Its downstream economic values, if any, are not classified as material.

ECONOMIC_MATERIALITY_ATTRITION.conditional_loss_rate: loss count divided by authoritative count

CANDIDATE_TRANSLATION_ATTRITION.conditional_loss_rate: loss count divided by material count

fixed_metrics.stage_share: Each stage loss count divided by the sum of the three stage loss counts. Because the stages form a nested funnel, the three losses sum to the 12-unit census.

fixed_integrity_gate: The census JSON retains its exact hash and lists 12 unique consecutive units 039-050 with program counts 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 4:2, 5:3 and 7:1.
All 12 closure files retain the listed bytes and SHA-256 values and parse as JSON with matching unit identity and a nonempty top-level verdict.
Every unit receives exactly one authority classification; every authoritative unit exactly one material classification; every material unit exactly one candidate-translation classification.
No invalid unit contributes a material finding or candidate and no unit is double-counted.

fixed_stage_gate.material_attrition: A stage passes when it loses at least three units and its conditional loss rate is at least 0.30.
fixed_stage_gate.concentration: Report stage shares. A single-stage-dominant diagnosis additionally requires exactly one passing stage and that stage to supply more than 0.60 of all funnel losses.
fixed_stage_gate.multi_stage: If all three stages pass and no stage supplies more than 0.60 of all funnel losses, the diagnosis is multi-stage.
fixed_stage_gate.two_stage: If exactly two stages pass, the diagnosis names those two without selecting a default research lane.
fixed_stage_gate.one_stage: If exactly one stage passes but does not exceed 0.60 share, record a bounded single-stage diagnosis without dominance.
fixed_stage_gate.none: If no stage passes, close with no material attrition topology.

fixed_verdict_rules.authority_limit: A diagnosis selects no program, evidence lane, hypothesis class, strategy, source, parameter, EA or Live action. It is finite process memory, not a scheduler or suppression rule.

stop_rules: Commit and push this census and declaration before aggregating verdict values, classifications, stage counts, rates, shares, gates or Unit 051 verdict.
Run exactly one fixed in-memory classification over the 12 pinned closure files.
Do not alter the epoch, add earlier or later units, omit invalid units, weight programs, reinterpret an underlying economic outcome or open an underlying family.
Do not use the result to impose a default evidence lane, mechanical program rotation, program suppression, threshold, candidate or automatic successor.
Do not modify MQL, compile, run MetaTrader, inspect Program 6, retain a CLI, query broker/account state or touch Live.
Close after one result and return to whole-map comparison without an adjacent Program 7 audit.
